title: SENSEX zooms 1,695 pts, NIFTY50 ends at 23,622 as US-Iran truce deal boosts sentiment; NIFTY Bank surges 3%
desc: NIFTY50 and SENSEX indices closed over 2% higher on Friday, June 12, after reports emerged of a draft MoU between the United States and Iran, which fuelled a 5% drop in global crude oil prices.

title: Indonesia Deploys Thousands of Security Forces as Students Protest Prabowo
desc: Indonesian police clashed with students in central Jakarta Friday, trying to contain a protest against the rising cost of living and President Prabowo Subianto’s spending plans.

title: Kenya holds a memorial service for 16 victims of last month's girls school fire
desc: Hundreds of mourners gathered in Kenya’s central town of Gilgil for a memorial service to honor the lives of 16 students who died in a school fire last month that police said was caused by arson

title: Kenny Jackett: Former Wolves, Millwall, Portsmouth and Swansea manager dies aged 64
